column1: # Test Case G: Three-Level Queue (Dean / Faculty-Staff / Student)
# Faculty*/Staff* -> FACULTY (Round Robin; urgent=1 runs to completion
# FCFS among urgent jobs); everything else -> STUDENT (SmartQueue
# starvation turn once a job waits >= tau_fair).
#   t=0  two Faculty/Staff jobs time-slice under Round Robin
#   t=4  urgent Faculty job (6) cuts in and runs to completion
#   t=6  Dean job (7) preempts the urgent job mid-print
#   t~12 waiting Student jobs cross tau_fair and get a starvation turn
#   t=22 second urgent Faculty job (13) queues behind nothing but the Dean
